info.title: Plot Twist API
info.description: Verified-user profiles and a shared authenticated story feed. OAuth2 Authorization Code + PKCE; machine grants cannot read user content. Story/comment authors are derived only from the verified JWT.

get.summary: Personalized semantic recommendations with an explicit cold-start/fallback mode
get.description: Qdrant retrieves candidates from locally computed E5 vectors. PostgreSQL rechecks visibility, story revision, current ratings and reading exclusions; no online inference is performed by this endpoint.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Private snapshot cursor, expires after 15 minutes; never reuse across accounts.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: Bypass the two-minute snapshot cache for the first page.

post.description: Approximate client telemetry; not proof of reading. Repeated events within one day do not repeatedly increment the interest revision. Only completed reading is a positive seed.
